title: Shield booster order
description: Doki's yard has four shield boosters on backorder and Przystań's fitters will take them. Manufacture or buy four units of Shield Booster, load them in the hold, and dock at Przystań — standing 0.10 with the Doki office first.

title: Web units for the yard
description: Huta's platform runs its ore lines with Stasis Web units from Doki, and the last shipment never arrived. Bring three units of Stasis Web to Doki's hangar — the order is open to pilots at standing 0.05.
